meta.scope: NBA-first fan merch + local businesses; can a merchant act on a day-T prediction-market signal to capture T+1..T+21 demand
meta.units: lead_time_days_* are calendar days (business-day figures converted ~x1.4); fractional = hours/24
meta.labels: [est] = analyst estimate; [secondary] = non-primary or vendor-marketing source

archetypes.name: Print-on-demand fan store (Printful / Printify / Gelato)
archetypes.description: Zero-inventory Shopify store; each order printed (DTG/DTF) and shipped by the POD provider. Typically unlicensed 'city/vibe' designs.

actions.action: Create design and publish synced Shopify listing
actions.cost_notes: Design labor only; mockups auto-generated. Printful markets 'time-to-market from 6 months to 1 hour or less' [2nd: vendor marketing]. Typical/slow include design time [est].

actions.action: POD production after order (fulfillment)
actions.cost_notes: Printful: 2-5 business days (>97% ship <=5 bd, >50% <=3 bd); Printify: most orders ship within 2-7 bd. Calendar-day conversion [est]. Peak season adds 2-5 days [2nd].

actions.action: US shipping after production
actions.cost_notes: Printful US standard 3-4 bd, express 1-3 bd. Customer-paid shipping typically ~$4 first tee [2nd].

actions.action: End-to-end order -> customer doorstep
actions.cost_notes: Printify Express: 2-3 bd total on select US products; typical total 7-12 days, worst 14-21 [2nd]. Gelato claims US delivery 3-5 days [vendor marketing].

actions.action: Launch new Meta ad (creative + ad set) and pass review
actions.cost_notes: Meta: review 'typically completed within 24 hours'; may take longer. Requires pre-built creative.

actions.action: Meta ad set exits learning phase (stable CPA)
actions.cost_notes: ~50 optimization events per ad set within 7 days => daily budget ~ 7x target CPA (e.g. $15 CPA -> ~$107/day). Budget edits >~20% (or targeting/creative/bid changes) can reset learning; 'Learning Limited' if 50/7d unreachable. Slow value = 2 resets [est].

actions.action: Google Ads smart-bidding calibration after change
actions.cost_notes: ~50 conversion events or ~3 conversion cycles; allow >=24h for ad review [2nd for 7-day norm].

actions.action: Send email campaign to existing list (Klaviyo)
actions.cost_notes: Minutes for send; SendGrid infrastructure reports median delivery 1.9 s. Copy/design time dominates [est].

actions.action: Send SMS campaign to existing subscribers (Klaviyo)
actions.cost_notes: Throughput 10 msg/s (toll-free/10DLC) => 100k msgs ~2.8 h; short code 100 msg/s => ~17 min. One-time setup must precede season: toll-free verification 7-10 business days, short code 8-12 weeks.

archetypes.overstock_notes: Not applicable: made to order, no unsold units. Downside limited to design time and ad spend. Gross margin excludes shipping and ads; Printful Growth/Business plans lower unit cost to $9.05/$8.45; Printify Gildan 5000 ~$7-9.
archetypes.notes: Can capture orders same day; physical delivery lags 3-12 days, which matters if fans want the item before a specific game.

archetypes.name: In-house DTF/DTG print shop on Shopify holding blanks
archetypes.description: Merchant holds blank tees (Gildan/Bella+Canvas from SanMar, S&S Activewear/alphabroder) and presses DTF transfers or prints DTG in-house; ships own orders.

actions.action: Restock blanks from US wholesaler (SanMar / S&S / alphabroder)
actions.cost_notes: SanMar: 9 DCs, same-day ship if ordered before cutoff (UPS Ground 4pm local; next-day air 1-4pm). S&S: 14 warehouses, 1-2 day delivery to most of US. alphabroder (S&S-owned since Oct 2024): 10 DCs, next-day to 96% of US population. Gildan 5000 ~$3.06-3.41/unit at $100-1,500 orders. Slow = color/size stockouts [est].

actions.action: Order DTF transfers / gang sheets (e.g. Ninja Transfers)
actions.cost_notes: Ninja: order before 3pm ET for same-day ship / Next Day Air (from ~$25.55-$28.11); 40% of orders ship next day; usually same/next bd production, up to 2-3 bd; standard ground 5-7 bd (free >$75). DTF list price from ~$0.03/sq in with up to 65% volume discount => ~$1.50-3.60 per 11x11 front [est].

actions.action: Press DTF transfers onto blanks (in-house)
actions.cost_notes: 30-60 s press per shirt (~1-2 min all-in) => ~60-120 shirts/hour per press+operator [est from Printify]. Labor ~$0.50-1.00/shirt [est].

actions.action: Print DTG in-house
actions.cost_notes: DTG 2-3 min/shirt print + pretreat/cure; production units e.g. Epson F3070 ~65 shirts/h, Kornit Storm II ~60/h [2nd].

actions.action: Ship to customer (UPS Ground / USPS)
actions.cost_notes: Carrier ground transit [est].

actions.action: Artwork proof and approval

actions.action: Standard screen-print production

actions.action: Freight from printer to merchant/3PL and receiving

actions.action: Open pre-orders on Shopify to measure demand before committing

archetypes.name: Restaurant / sports bar near the arena
archetypes.description: Local on-premise business whose demand spikes on home playoff game nights (and watch parties for away games).

actions.action: Reorder food from broadline distributor (US Foods / Sysco)
actions.cost_notes: US Foods Pronto: 8pm cutoff for next-day delivery, 6 days/week, no minimum (charges <10 cases), 76 metro areas. Sysco: branch-specific cutoffs (e.g. Hawaii 4pm day-before); orders editable until cutoff in Sysco Shop. Accounts without daily routes wait for next scheduled delivery day [est].

actions.action: Add/adjust staff shifts - independent venue not covered by fair-workweek law
actions.cost_notes: Most independent bars/restaurants fall below coverage thresholds; constraint is staff availability [est].

actions.action: Add/adjust staff shifts - covered chain (NYC fast food; Chicago/Seattle/Philadelphia large restaurant chains)
actions.cost_notes: Penalty-free only with 14 days' notice. NYC fast food premiums per change: $10 (add/shift, <14d), $20 (reduce, <14d), $15 (add, <7d), $45 (reduce, <7d), $75 (reduce <24h). Chicago/Seattle: +1 hour pay per change. Coverage: Chicago restaurants 30+ locations & 250+ employees; Seattle full-service 40+ locations & 500+ employees; Philadelphia 250+ employees & 30+ locations; LA City ordinance retail-only.

actions.action: Game-day promotion via social / email / SMS
actions.cost_notes: Hours [est].

archetypes.overstock_notes: Estimates: food+beverage cost ~30-35% of sales (industry rule of thumb, not sourced here). Salvage: perishables low, shelf-stable beer/liquor high; blended ~30% [est]. Uplift evidence: near-arena restaurant spend +15-84% on Canadiens home playoff games 2026 (NHL analog); Toronto bar transactions +76% at 11pm after Raptors ECF G6 (2019). Away games/Sundays flat or negative.
archetypes.notes: Signal most useful as probability of a HOME game on a given date (Games 5-7 are 'if necessary').

archetypes.name: Hotel / short-term rental near the arena
archetypes.description: Room-night inventory is fixed and perishable; the lever is price, minimum stay and restrictions set before bookings arrive.

actions.action: Reprice via hotel RMS (IDeaS / Duetto)
actions.cost_notes: Continuous/real-time pricing between floor and ceiling; slow = once-daily optimization cadence [est].

actions.action: Reprice STR via PriceLabs (or similar)
actions.cost_notes: Default nightly sync (1-3x/day with add-on); Real-Time Sync up to 24 updates/day, min 60 min between triggers.

actions.action: Set min-stay / close-out restrictions
actions.cost_notes: Same channel-manager mechanics as price [est].

actions.action: Housekeeping/front-desk staffing (Chicago hotels covered by Fair Workweek)
actions.cost_notes: Chicago covers hotels with >100 employees globally: 14-day notice, 1h predictability pay per change.

archetypes.overstock_notes: Unsold room-nights perish (0% salvage); the cost of a late signal is underpricing, not overstock. Evidence: Indianapolis 2025 Finals Game 4 ADR only +2% vs 30 days prior ('missed opportunity'); OKC hotel search +45% vs 22-month average; Milwaukee 2021 Finals rooms $400+/night.
archetypes.notes: Acts in minutes; value of the signal is moving rates before the booking wave.

events.headline: Mavericks trade Luka Doncic to Lakers for Anthony Davis (3-team deal with Jazz)
events.detail: Reported by ESPN's Shams Charania late Sat Feb 1 / just after midnight ET Feb 2; ESPN story timestamp 12:21 AM ET Feb 2 (initial social post minutes earlier, exact minute unverified). LAL get Doncic, Kleber, Morris; DAL get Davis, Max Christie, LAL 2029 1st; UTA get Hood-Schifino + 2nds. Doncic had not requested a trade; first time two reigning All-NBA players swapped midseason.

events.headline: Kings trade De'Aaron Fox to Spurs in 3-team deal (Zach LaVine to Sacramento)
events.detail: Spurs announced the deal Monday Feb 3, 2025 (first reported the prior night; exact report time unverified). SAS get Fox + Jordan McLaughlin; SAC get LaVine, Sidy Cissoko, three 1sts, three 2nds; CHI get Zach Collins, Tre Jones, Kevin Huerter and their 2025 1st back.

events.headline: Heat trade Jimmy Butler to Warriors in five-team deal
events.detail: Reported Wed Feb 5, 2025 shortly before GSW-UTA tip (time = ESPN story timestamp). GSW send Wiggins, Kyle Anderson, top-10-protected 2025 1st to MIA; Schroder to UTA; Lindy Waters to DET. Butler opted out and agreed to 2-yr/$111M extension. Ended a ~2-month saga with three Heat suspensions.

events.headline: Anthony Davis strains left adductor in Mavericks debut
events.detail: Davis had 26 pts/16 reb in DAL's 116-105 win over HOU but left in the 3rd quarter; out multiple weeks (about six). Undercut the Davis side of the Doncic trade immediately.

events.headline: Luka Doncic makes Lakers debut vs. Jazz (first game since Christmas calf strain)
events.detail: 14 pts in ~24 min in a 132-113 win; first appearance since a Dec 25, 2024 calf strain.

events.headline: Victor Wembanyama ruled out for season with deep vein thrombosis (right shoulder)
events.detail: Diagnosed after All-Star weekend; Spurs said not career-threatening. Removed the Fox+Wembanyama pairing for the rest of 2024-25.

events.headline: Kyrie Irving tears left ACL vs. Kings; out for season
events.detail: Injury Mar 3; torn ACL announced Mar 4. Compounded post-Doncic-trade collapse; DAL later lost in play-in.

events.headline: Jalen Brunson sprains right ankle vs. Lakers; out at least 2 weeks
events.detail: Injured in OT of a 113-109 loss to LAL; returned in final two weeks of regular season.

events.headline: Nuggets fire coach Michael Malone and GM Calvin Booth with 3 games left
events.detail: Unprecedented late-season change; David Adelman named interim (hired full-time May 22, 2025). DEN were 47-32 on a 4-game skid.

events.headline: Thunder sweep Grizzlies 4-0 (1st round)
events.detail: Game 4 at Memphis, OKC 117-115.

events.headline: Damian Lillard tears left Achilles in Game 4 vs. Pacers
events.detail: Third game back from a right-calf DVT; MIL lost 129-103 to fall behind 3-1. Confirmed by MRI Apr 28. Rival-star shock for IND.

events.headline: No. 1 Cavaliers sweep Heat 4-0
events.detail: Game 4 at Miami, CLE 138-83.

events.headline: Pacers eliminate Bucks 4-1 in overtime Game 5
events.detail: IND 119-118 (OT) at home.

events.headline: Celtics eliminate Magic 4-1
events.detail: BOS 120-89 in Game 5.

events.headline: Timberwolves eliminate Doncic's Lakers 4-1 (1st round)
events.detail: MIN 103-96 at LAL in Game 5. Ends the first Doncic-Lakers playoff run within 3 months of the trade.

events.headline: Knicks eliminate Pistons 4-2
events.detail: NYK 116-113 in Game 6 at Detroit.

events.headline: Nuggets beat Clippers in Game 7
events.detail: DEN 120-101 at home.

events.headline: Warriors (7) beat No. 2 Rockets in Game 7
events.detail: GSW 103-89 at Houston.

events.headline: Stephen Curry strains left hamstring in Game 1 at Minnesota
events.detail: Grade 1 strain, left in 2nd quarter; GSW still won 99-88 but Curry missed the rest of the series (GSW lost 4-1).

events.headline: Jayson Tatum ruptures right Achilles late in Game 4 at MSG
events.detail: Injured with 2:58 left in Q4 (approx. 9:45-10:00 PM ET; tip 7:30 PM) of a 121-113 NYK win; NYK led series 3-1. Surgery May 13. Out most/all of 2025-26.

events.headline: Rival-star shock for Knicks: Tatum's Achilles rupture removes defending champs' best player
events.detail: Mirror record of the Tatum injury from the Knicks' perspective (NYK up 3-1). NYK closed the series 4 days later and reached first ECF since 2000.

events.headline: Mavericks win 2025 draft lottery with 1.8% odds (No. 1 pick -> Cooper Flagg)
events.detail: 4th-lowest odds to win since 1985; SAS 2nd, PHI 3rd, CHA 4th. Revived fan anger/'rigged' claims over the Doncic trade.

events.headline: Pacers eliminate No. 1 Cavaliers 4-1
events.detail: IND 114-105 at Cleveland in Game 5.

events.headline: Timberwolves eliminate Curry-less Warriors 4-1
events.detail: MIN 121-110 in Game 5.

events.headline: Knicks eliminate defending-champion Celtics 4-2; first ECF since 2000

events.headline: Thunder beat Timberwolves 4-1 to win West, reach first Finals since 2012
events.detail: OKC 124-94 in Game 5.

events.headline: Pacers eliminate Knicks 4-2 in ECF; reach first Finals since 2000
events.detail: IND 125-108 in Game 6 at Indianapolis.

events.headline: Knicks fire Tom Thibodeau days after ECF loss

events.detail: First Finals Game 7 since 2016.

events.headline: Suns trade Kevin Durant to Rockets (later a record 7-team trade)
events.detail: Reported the afternoon of Finals Game 7 (time = ESPN story timestamp). PHX get Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, No. 10 pick, five 2nds; finalized July 6, 2025 as a 7-team, 13-player deal.

events.detail: Injured with 4:55 left in Q1 (approx. 8:20 PM ET); IND still led 48-47 at half before OKC pulled away.

events.detail: Mirror record of the Haliburton injury from OKC's perspective; an in-game probability shock just before the title was decided.

events.headline: Thunder win 2025 NBA championship, beat Pacers 103-91 in Game 7

events.headline: Celtics trade Jrue Holiday to Trail Blazers for Anfernee Simons

meta.method: WebSearch budget was exhausted, so labels come from primary sources fetched directly: official NBA injury-report PDFs (ak-static.cms.nba.com, ET timestamps, 15-60 min cadence), ESPN news feed by date (now.core.api.espn.com), ESPN game summaries (tip/end wallclock), Wikipedia wikitext. 'unexplained' means none of those showed relevant news in the ~12h before onset.
meta.notes: 25-IND-062116 and 25-OKC-062114 are the same event seen from both sides (they mirror each other at the same hour). The sid '26-OKC-061816-check' is kept as given, but it refers to the NYK 13.75->16.15 move on 2026-05-18/19 UTC.

labels.headline: No Celtics or rival news found (Celtics idle day)
labels.detail: BOS was idle on Nov 9; its last game, a 108-104 OT win vs BKN, ended ~03:30Z Nov 9. Jaylen Brown (hip flexor) was first upgraded to questionable in the 5:00 PM ET report (22:00Z), 5h AFTER onset, and his return was confirmed Nov 10 ~19:00Z. No other BOS or contender news turned up in the ESPN feed or injury reports.

labels.headline: Weak candidate only: Jrue Holiday added as questionable (knee) for Nov 16
labels.detail: Jrue Holiday first appeared as QUESTIONABLE (left knee tendinopathy) in the 11/15 5:30 PM ET injury report (22:30Z), 11.5h before onset; he then sat out the Nov 16 game vs TOR. A regular-season questionable tag is too small to explain a 4-pt title move. The only other overnight event was CLE going 14-0 (game ended ~03:00Z Nov 16). Most likely thin-book drift.

labels.headline: No Cavaliers news found before CLE@LAL
labels.detail: CLE had no injury-report entries and no ESPN news on Dec 30-31. Nearby events: CLE beat GSW 113-95 (ended ~05:30Z Dec 31), and Porzingis was moved to OUT for BOS-TOR in the 2 PM ET report (19:00Z). Neither is credible for a +3.25-pt title move. CLE's next tip was 02:00Z Jan 1.

labels.headline: Garland, Mobley, Hunter take part in Game 3 shootaround, trending toward playing
labels.detail: All three had been QUESTIONABLE since the 5 PM ET May 8 report. Per ESPN, they 'participated in shootaround earlier in the day' on May 9 (late morning ET, which lines up with the 15:00Z onset). The official upgrade to AVAILABLE came in the 7 PM ET report (23:00Z), and CLE won Game 3 126-104. The exact time of the shootaround reports is approximate.

labels.headline: No news found on the off-day after Finals Game 6
labels.detail: Game 6 (IND 108-91) ended ~02:45Z Jun 20. There were no injury-report changes on Jun 20; Haliburton (calf) was next listed as questionable in the 5 PM ET Jun 21 report. The ESPN feed has no Pacers or Thunder news that day. This is the mirror image of 25-OKC-062114 at the same hour, so it is probably delayed post-G6 repricing toward a Game 7 coin-flip rather than news.

labels.headline: Mavericks trade Luka Doncic to Lakers for Anthony Davis (3-team deal)
labels.detail: Shams Charania (ESPN) broke the trade at 12:16 a.m. ET Feb 2, 2025 (05:16Z). The onset came ~1.7h later.

labels.headline: Haliburton hampered by right calf injury in Game 5 (rival star)
labels.detail: ESPN's postgame story (1:27 AM ET Jun 17 = 05:27Z) reported Haliburton was limited by a sore right calf ('If I can walk, then I want to play'), 6.5h before onset. The follow-up Shams report (calf strain, MRI, likely questionable for G6) came at 3:08 PM ET (19:08Z), after onset, and may have extended the move. He was first listed questionable in the 5 PM ET Jun 18 report.

labels.headline: No news found on the off-day after Finals Game 6 (mirror of IND move)
labels.detail: This is the same event as 25-IND-062116. There was no injury-report change on Jun 20 and no OKC or IND news in the ESPN feed. Game 6 ended ~02:45Z Jun 20, 13h before onset. Likely post-G6 repricing or drift.

labels.headline: OG Anunoby (hamstring) moved from OUT to QUESTIONABLE for Game 4 at PHI
labels.detail: Anunoby had been OUT for Game 3. The 5:00 PM ET May 9 report (21:00Z) listed him QUESTIONABLE for Game 4 (NYK up 3-0), which signals he is near a return; he was ruled out again at 2:30 PM ET May 10, after onset. The 12h lag is long and no other NYK news was found. Overnight context: DET (East #1) lost Game 3 to CLE (ended 21:52Z May 9) and OKC went 7-0 (ended 03:00Z May 10).

labels.headline: Delayed overnight repricing after OKC's 138-89 Cup quarterfinal rout (24-1 start)
labels.detail: No off-court news was found: no OKC or contender injury-report changes Dec 10-11, and nothing relevant in the ESPN feed. OKC's 49-point NBA Cup QF win over PHX ended 02:49Z Dec 11, about 6h before onset, so this looks like late repricing in thin overnight trading rather than news.

labels.headline: Thunder rule Ajay Mitchell (calf/soleus strain) out of WCF Game 4; Jalen Williams questionable
labels.detail: The 6:30 PM ET May 23 injury report (22:30Z), and ESPN at 6:33 PM ET, listed Ajay Mitchell OUT (right soleus/calf strain, a new injury) and Jalen Williams QUESTIONABLE (hamstring). At 22:37Z, Spurs coach Mitch Johnson said Fox and Harper would play. Williams was downgraded to OUT at 7:30 PM ET May 24, after onset. Game 4 tipped 00:13Z May 25 (SAS won 103-82). The 15-pt size and 11.5h lag suggest part of the move is pre-G4 repricing in a thin book.

labels.headline: No pregame news before Spurs at Wolves Game 4
labels.detail: SAS had no injury-report entries all day (only MIN's DiVincenzo was out), and the whole roster played. Tip was 23:43Z, 1.7h after onset. The only nearby event was NYK finishing its sweep of PHI at 22:11Z, which is not credible for -4 pts on SAS. If the onset estimate is early, the likely in-game cause is Wembanyama's flagrant-2 ejection at 00:21-00:24Z May 11.

labels.headline: NYK 13.75->16.15 (May 18-19) coincides with real rival results, so not obviously noise
labels.detail: Three things fit the window. (1) CLE eliminated East #1 DET 125-94 in Game 7, ending 02:48Z May 18, so NYK avoided DET. (2) Anunoby was listed PROBABLE for ECF Game 1 in the 5:00 PM ET May 18 report (21:00Z), after missing the end of the PHI series. (3) SAS beat title favorite OKC 122-115 in 2OT in WCF Game 1, ending 03:43Z May 19. NYK's own Game 1 tipped 00:13Z May 20. Which event applies depends on the exact onset hour.
